name: Honda Amaze
description:
The Honda Amaze represents the pinnacle of compact sedan engineering, focusing heavily on cabin space and ride refinement. The renowned 1.2-liter i-VTEC engine operates with minimal noise, vibration, and harshness (NVH), ensuring a remarkably quiet cabin environment even at highway speeds. With its massive 420-liter trunk capacity, it seamlessly accommodates heavy luggage, making it the ideal vehicle for airport transfers.

Specifications:
* Fuel: Petrol
* Engine: 1.2L i-VTEC (1199cc)
* Transmission: Manual
* Seats: 5 Passengers
* Boot: 420 Liters
